text:
dave (Acme Retail): Hey @support — saw a large unexpected charge on INV-2025-09-914. Invoice token total = 184,720 but our dashboard shows ~18,472 for the same period. CFO is asking for an explanation and provisional refund.

alice (Support): Sorry about that, @dave. Can you paste a link to the invoice and one or two sample request IDs? Also: when did you first notice the discrepancy?

dave (Acme Retail): Invoice link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2025-09-914
Sample req: req_7f3b2a (2025-09-01T00:02:14Z)
We noticed it after morning reconciliation at 09:30 UTC. Looks like a ~10x token multiplier for a window around 00:00-01:00 UTC.

alice (Support): Tagging @ben (Billing) and @carol (Finance) to triage. I'll open SUP-2025-839 and attach logs.

ben (Billing): I pulled ledger rows for INV-2025-09-914. There's a burst of usage events from 2025-09-01T00:00:00Z -> 2025-09-01T00:18:00Z. Many events look duplicated (same request_id, different event_id). Investigating ingestion retries -> dedupe failure.

deploy-bot: deploy embed-service:v2.3.1 to prod at 2025-09-01T00:01:05Z :rocket:

ben (Billing): correlation looks strong with that deploy. Possible regression in the client retry handling + ingest dedupe. Initial duped token count delta = ~166,248 tokens.

carol (Finance): If the duplicate tokens are confirmed, we need a provisional credit and a revrec note for month-end. Please include: invoice id, provisional credit TXN ID, token delta, USD amount, and GL reversal lines. Controller approval required for credits > $5k.

alice (Support): Initial provisional credit calc = $1,247.98 (based on $0.0075 per 1k tokens tier from invoice). Propose provisional credit PC-2025-091 and hold until ledger reconciliation.

ben (Billing): SQL to find duplicates if helpful:
```sql
SELECT request_id, COUNT(*) as hits, SUM(tokens) as tokens_total
FROM usage_events
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2025-09-02'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
This returns ~1,120 request_ids with duplicate rows.

dave (Acme Retail): Can you confirm timeline for provisional credit and full refund? Need something to tell the CFO.

ben (Billing): We can post provisional credit within 48 hours once support confirms mapping to the invoice. Final adjustment after ledger recompute and accounting signoff — target 7-10 business days.

carol (Finance): For revrec impact, we'll book a reversal against GL 4000 - Cloud Revenue, memo: "INV-2025-09-914 duplicate usage reversal". Please add a supporting spreadsheet with sample request_ids and before/after token totals. I need signoff by 2025-09-10 EOD to include in the monthly close.

alice (Support): Repro steps for the duplication seen in logs:
1) embed-service v2.3.1 receives response timeout on first attempt (client sees 408)
2) client retries and server incorrectly accepted the retry as a new usage event (missing idempotency key)
3) ingest pipeline lacked strict dedupe when event_id differs but request_id matches

Log snippet from embed-service: 
```
[2025-09-01T00:01:06Z] WARN request=req_7f3b2a attempt=1 error=timeout
[2025-09-01T00:01:07Z] INFO request=req_7f3b2a attempt=2 received 200 tokens=167
[2025-09-01T00:01:07Z] INFO ingest event_id=evt_aa12 request_id=req_7f3b2a tokens=167
[2025-09-01T00:01:07Z] INFO ingest event_id=evt_bb34 request_id=req_7f3b2a tokens=167
```
We can see two ingest events for same request_id.

ben (Billing): Action plan:
- Support to supply mapping SUP-2025-839 with sample request_ids and logs (Alice)
- Billing to run dedupe job and produce corrected ledger rows (Ben)
- Finance to prepare provisional credit transaction and revrec memo (Carol)
- Ops to roll back/patch idempotency in embed-service (Ops)

alice (Support): I've uploaded initial evidence to the ticket and added a CSV of 50 sample duped request_ids. Filing provisional credit PC-2025-091 for $1,247.98 against INV-2025-09-914.

carol (Finance): I approve provisional credit PC-2025-091. Controller signoff recorded. Please include memo line: "Provisional credit pending ledger reconciliation - SUP-2025-839".

ben (Billing): Executed provisional credit txn PC-2025-091, posted as pending. Final reconciliation ETA 7 business days. Will update invoice to reflect provisional credit on customer portal.

dave (Acme Retail): Thanks — appreciate the quick response. Please confirm final credit/refund once done and send a reconciliation file we can match to our GL.

alice (Support): Will do. Closing loop here when final ledger recompute complete. :thumbsup:

carol (Finance): Reminder for records: revrec impact code REVREC-SEP-2025-ADJ, amount $1,247.98, will reduce recognized revenue for Sep by same amount pending final clearance.

ben (Billing): Marking SUP-2025-839 as investigating -> provisional-credit-applied. Final state will be: reconciled / credited / no further action or reconciled / charged-back if dispute rejected.

dave (Acme Retail): Noted. One more ask — can you add a short note for auditors describing the root cause and controls added?

alice (Support): Yes — will attach RCA and control plan (idempotency keys + stricter dedupe) to the ticket.

ben (Billing): ETA for final ledger publish: 2025-09-10. I'll post a reconciliation CSV to SUP-2025-839 when done.

dave (Acme Retail): Great. Thanks everyone.

[thread closed provisional credit applied PC-2025-091]
